sections.preamble: You are an expert coding assistant operating inside pi, a coding agent harness. You help users by reading files, executing commands, editing code, and writing new files.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- bash: Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.)
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call
- write: Create or overwrite files
- ask_user_question: Ask the user up to 4 structured questions (2-4 options each) when requirements are ambiguous
- subagents_enable: pi-subagents is installed. For authorized specialist, independent-review, or parallel work, call subagents_enable, then subagent. Authorization must come from the current request or applicable instructions; complexity alone is not authorization.
- codemode: Run JavaScript that calls other tools

In addition to the tools above, you may have access to other custom tools depending on the project.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use bash for file operations like ls, rg, find
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- You can inspect PI_* environment variables for current model and session details.
- Use edit for precise changes (edits[].oldText must match exactly)
- When changing multiple separate locations in one file, use one edit call with multiple entries in edits[] instead of multiple edit calls
- Each edits[].oldText is matched against the original file, not after earlier edits are applied. Do not emit overlapping or nested edits. Merge nearby changes into one edit.
- Keep edits[].oldText as small as possible while still being unique in the file. Do not pad with large unchanged regions.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use ask_user_question whenever the user's request is underspecified and you cannot proceed without concrete decisions — you can ask up to 4 questions per invocation.
- Each question MUST have 2-4 options. Every option requires a concise label (1-5 words) and a description explaining what the choice means or its trade-offs. The user can additionally type a custom answer via the automatically appended "Type something." row on every question, or press Esc to abandon the questionnaire. Do NOT author "Other" or "Type something." labels yourself — reserved labels are rejected at runtime.
- Set multiSelect: true when multiple answers are valid. Provide an options[].preview markdown string when an option benefits from richer side-by-side context (mockups, code snippets, diagrams, configs) — single-select only. The "Type something." row is appended to every question; in preview mode it expands to the full pane width while typing so the custom answer is not cramped into the narrow options column. If you recommend a specific option, make that the first option and append "(Recommended)" to its label.
- Do not stack multiple ask_user_question calls back-to-back — group all clarifying questions into one invocation.
- Use codemode to batch independent tool calls (Promise.allSettled), chain them, or filter large output, instead of many separate calls.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

# AGENTS.md — Marketplace Monorepo

## 1. Project Overview & Architecture

**Okcir marketplace** is an e-commerce monorepo: a storefront for customers, an
admin dashboard for operations, and a shared database package, managed with npm
workspaces. Products, stock, and branch data are synced from **Jubelio**
(master-data API, see `docs/features/jubelio-sync.md`).

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `apps/store` | Storefront (customers) — http://localhost:3000 |
| `apps/admin` | Admin dashboard (ops) — http://localhost:3001 |
| `packages/db` | 🏛️ Shared schema owner (`@marketplace/db`) |
| `.scratch/<feature>/` | Workflow artifacts: research, plans, wayfinding, tickets + per-feature `index.md` |

**Stack:** Next.js 16 (App Router) · PostgreSQL 16 + Drizzle ORM · Better Auth
(two instances) · TypeScript · Tailwind + shadcn/ui.

**Architecture facts you must know (deep-dives linked):**

- **Schema lives ONLY in `packages/db/src/schema/`.** Apps are read-only
  consumers via the `@marketplace/db` alias. → [`docs/architecture/database.md`](docs/architecture/database.md)
- **Two independent Better Auth instances** — store (`clients`, `client.*`
  cookies) vs admin (`users`, `admin.*`). → [`docs/architecture/auth.md`](docs/architecture/auth.md)
- **Route protection is per-app middleware** (store: cart/checkout/account +
  onboarding gate; admin: `/admin/*`). → [`docs/architecture/middleware.md`](docs/architecture/middleware.md)
- Each app has its own local `db` instance; the shared package's `db` is for
  scripts only. → [`docs/architecture/overview.md`](docs/architecture/overview.md)

**More context:** [`README.md`](README.md) · [`docs/README.md`](docs/README.md).

## 2. Build, Test, & Run Commands

Run all `db:*` scripts from the **root** (they `cd` into `packages/db`).

### Dev setup (order matters)

1. `docker compose up -d` — PostgreSQL 16 on port 5432 (DB: `storefront`)
2. `cp .env.example .env` — configure `DATABASE_URL`, `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`,
   Google OAuth + SMTP vars
3. `npm install` — installs workspace deps (hoisted to root)
4. `npm run db:push` — apply schema
5. `npm run db:seed` — seed sample data
6. `npm run dev:store` — storefront on http://localhost:3000
7. `npm run dev:admin` — admin on http://localhost:3001

### Common scripts

| Script | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `dev:store` / `dev:admin` / `dev:all` | Run one app / both apps in dev |
| `build` / `build:store` / `build:admin` | Production build(s) |
| `db:generate` / `db:push` | Generate Drizzle migration / apply to DB |
| `db:seed` / `db:reset` | Seed / reset + reseed the DB |
| `db:studio` / `db:check` | Drizzle Studio / schema check |
| `db:import-jubelio` | Pull Jubelio master data |
| `db:bootstrap-owner` | One-time System Owner bootstrap CLI (RBAC) |
| `lint` / `lint:store` / `lint:admin` | ESLint |
| `test:unit` | Vitest unit tests (workspace: store, admin, db) |
| `test:e2e` / `test:e2e:headed` | Playwright E2E — headless / visible browser |
| `test:e2e:ui` | Playwright UI mode (interactive browser runner) |
| `test:e2e:install` | Install Playwright browsers (Chromium) |

> **Testing prerequisites:** `test:unit` needs no infrastructure; `test:e2e`
> needs Postgres up + seeded, Chromium installed (`test:e2e:install`), and
> auto-starts both dev servers. See [`docs/testing/README.md`](docs/testing/README.md).

> ⚠️ **Use `db:push`, NOT `db:migrate`** (dev). The dev DB is schema-sync
> managed; the `__drizzle_migrations` journal is not kept in sync, so
> `db:migrate` replays old `CREATE TABLE`s and fails with `relation already
> exists`. Generated SQL in `packages/db/drizzle/` is the audit record — never
> hand-edit or delete it. (Deployment containers run `drizzle-kit migrate` — see
> `docs/deployment-docs/`.)

## 3. Coding Style & Conventions

- **TypeScript everywhere**; Next.js App Router, Server Components by default.
- **shadcn/ui** components in `apps/<app>/src/components/ui/`; app components
  in `apps/<app>/src/components/`.
- **Route conventions:** store under `/{products,cart,checkout,account,
  onboarding,login,register,forgot-password,reset-password,auth/verify}`;
  admin under `/admin/{dashboard,products,orders,users,marketing,analytics}`.
- **Path aliases:** `@/*` → `src/*`; `@marketplace/db` → `packages/db/src`
  (details: [`docs/architecture/overview.md`](docs/architecture/overview.md)).
- **Every timestamp column uses `timestamptz`** (`withTimezone: true`) — never
  bare `timestamp`; send `Date` objects on insert. (Details:
  [`docs/architecture/database.md`](docs/architecture/database.md).)
- **Backend structure and logging follow the `maintainable-code` skill** —
  feature-first `route.ts` → `*-service.ts` → `*-repository.ts` / `*-client.ts`,
  one service per business operation, no query inside `route.ts`, and
  module-scoped loggers that are never passed as parameters. Read
  [`.agents/skills/maintainable-code/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/maintainable-code/SKILL.md)
  and [`docs/architecture/code-organization.md`](docs/architecture/code-organization.md)
  before writing or restructuring backend code.
- **Logging is mandatory for backend logic** — every change to `/api/**` code
  must log through the app's structured logger (`apps/store/src/lib/logger.ts`
  / `apps/admin/src/lib/logger.ts`): minimum `info` on success, `error` with
  context on failure. Details: [`docs/features/logging.md`](docs/features/logging.md).
- Keep AGENTS.md in **English**. For generated documents, follow the
  **Indonesian documentation policy** in §6.
- **Bahasa dokumentasi:** seluruh dokumen project yang dibuat atau di-generate
  harus menggunakan **bahasa Indonesia**, termasuk AGENTS.md, research notes,
  plans, spesifikasi, decision/implementation tickets, wayfinder maps, ADRs,
  READMEs, dan dokumentasi teknis untuk code. Gunakan bahasa Indonesia untuk
  judul, headings, dan isi; pertahankan English technical/product terms yang
  familiar jika lebih jelas. Jangan menerjemahkan code identifiers, paths,
  commands, URLs, metadata tracker yang machine-readable, atau kutipan sumber
  verbatim. Aturan ini menggantikan default bahasa pada skills/templates,
  kecuali pengguna secara eksplisit meminta bahasa lain. Dokumen existing
  tidak perlu diterjemahkan massal kecuali diminta.

## 4. Agent Constraints & Boundaries

- **Align and approve before acting.** Verify repo facts; ask the user about
  unresolved behavior and scope rather than guessing. For nontrivial work,
  confirm shared understanding before drafting, then obtain explicit user
  approval of the **complete** plan/spec before Ready or implementation;
  orchestrator self-review is not approval. Obtain separate approval of a
  multi-session ticket breakdown before publishing it. Small, well-defined
  requests may proceed from agreed conversational scope without a plan file.
  Stop for new product decisions; do not silently re-plan. Read the on-demand
  [`development-workflow` skill](.agents/skills/development-workflow/SKILL.md)
  for the full process and gates.
- **Write the technical and UX blueprint before implementation.** A nontrivial
  spec/plan carries, inside the same file, the file-level technical blueprint
  (full paths, responsibility, layer, exported contract, test seam) and the UX
  blueprint (reference page, component reuse map, state matrix with final copy,
  viewport/accessibility). Both are an **advisory checklist**: unfilled parts
  become open items, and a requested prototype is the binding reference for
  flow, structure, and states while existing tokens/components stay the visual
  source of truth. A small single-session change may use a 4–6 line mini
  version. Details: [`development-workflow` §2](.agents/skills/development-workflow/SKILL.md)
  and [`ux-design` §3](.agents/skills/ux-design/SKILL.md).
- **Subagents are opt-in, bounded, and edit-only implementers.** Spawn only
  when the user explicitly authorizes delegation for the current task/session;
  plan approval is not permission. For implementation handoffs, subagents may
  read and edit files (including code, tests, and docs), but must not run unit
  tests, E2E tests, builds, lint, typechecks, or other validation commands.
  They hand back their changes and a concise report, then stop. The main agent
  owns integration, review, and all validation: inspect the changes, run the
  relevant tests/checks, and decide any follow-up edits. No nested subagents
  without separate permission. Follow the skill's handoff, isolation, and
  loop-stop rules. Implementation handoffs use the project `implementer` agent
  ([`.agents/agents/implementer.md`](.agents/agents/implementer.md)), whose tool
  allowlist has no shell — a child cannot run validation even by accident. The
  main agent owns the verification ladder in §5.
- **Plan → execute → review applies to any behavior-affecting change.** "Code"
  is broadly defined — no loopholes: app code, config/env files, schema files,
  seeders, middleware/route configs, files under `deployment/`. Pure research,
  standalone planning, and research/plan documents (e.g. under `.scratch/` or
  `docs/`) are exempt. Workflow artifacts live in `.scratch/<feature>/` with
  plan status tracked only in that feature's `index.md` — see
  [`.scratch/README.md`](.scratch/README.md).
  Implement approved scope one verifiable slice at a time; review against the
  approved behavior and repo standards before accepting the result.
- **Load the matching skill first** — the lookup is mandatory before
  implementation, for the main agent **and** for an authorized implementer
  subagent: `ux-design` (all coding; mandatory UX and cross-page consistency
  gates for frontend), `maintainable-code` (backend structure, service/repository
  boundaries, contextual logging), `tdd` (tests), `systematic-debugging` (bugs,
  test failures, unexpected behavior — never guess a fix), `nextjs` (UI),
  `better-auth-best-practices` (auth), `frontend-design` (visual polish within
  the established design system). If subagents are used, they must load the
  matching skill too; subagent use never bypasses a rule, and loading a skill
  never grants scope, delegation, or commit/remote permission that the user did
  not approve separately.
- **Mandatory UX skill lookup before coding, especially frontend development.**
  Read [`.agents/skills/ux-design/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/ux-design/SKILL.md)
  in full before any coding task; merely naming the skill is not loading it.
  For frontend development (pages, components, forms, navigation, layout,
  styling, themes/tokens, and interaction states), apply its task-flow,
  clickability, concise-copy, spacing, accessibility, and cross-page consistency
  gates. Reuse the established shared components and design tokens; do not
  invent a different visual style per page. `ux-design` usability and consistency
  requirements take precedence over conflicting aesthetic advice in
  `frontend-design`. For backend-only work without UX impact, record that the
  visual gates are not applicable. This requirement also applies to authorized
  implementer subagents; the main agent still owns all validation.
- **Context7 inquiry is mandatory before implementation.** Model knowledge stops
  at its training cut-off, so never write library/framework API code from
  memory. Before the first code slice that touches an external package
  (Next.js 16, React, Drizzle ORM/drizzle-kit, Better Auth, Zod, Tailwind,
  Playwright, Vitest, etc.):
  1. `mcp__context7__resolve_library_id` with `{ libraryName: "<package>" }`
     to get the canonical library ID for the installed version.
  2. `mcp__context7__query_docs` with
     `{ libraryId: "<id>", query: "<specific API question>" }` for every
     uncertain signature, option, migration, or deprecation.
  3. Record the library ID and what was confirmed in the plan/ticket/slice notes
     (e.g. `Context7 checkpoint: <id> — <what was verified>`), so review can
     audit it.
  These tools come from the project server in `.pi/mcp.json` (OAuth, exposure
  `direct`). If a lookup fails with `needs sign-in`, run `/mcp login context7`
  (or `pi mcp login context7`) and retry. Skip the lookup only when the slice
  touches no external API surface (pure refactor of already-confirmed code,
  CSS/layout tweaks, docs, repo-internal logic), and say so in one line.
  Subagents cannot call MCP tools (the `implementer` allowlist has neither
  shell nor MCP), so the main agent runs the inquiry and passes the confirmed
  signatures/options into the handoff packet; "the subagent should check
  Context7" is not a valid handoff. If Context7 is unreachable, fall back to
  the installed package types/source in `node_modules` or official vendor docs
  and state which source replaced it — silent guessing is a violation. Setup:
  [`docs/agents/mcp-tooling.md`](docs/agents/mcp-tooling.md).
- **Schema edits ONLY in `packages/db/src/schema/`** — apps never define tables.
- **Never treat the two Better Auth instances interchangeably** — cross-type
  sign-in is rejected by session hooks (`INVALID_USER_TYPE`).
- **Onboarding is store-only** — never assume a `role`/onboarding field on the
  wrong table.
- **Keep the seeder in sync with schema** — when tables/columns change, update
  `packages/db/src/seed.ts` (FK-ordered `DELETE` + realistic rows) so
  `db:reset && db:seed` yields a testable DB. Details:
  [`docs/architecture/database.md`](docs/architecture/database.md).
- **Deployment-aware** — when a change touches env vars, domains/URLs/ports,
  cron/webhook endpoints, volumes/healthchecks, or build steps, update the
  matching files under `deployment/` (`common/`, `staging/`, `production/`).
  See [`docs/deployment-docs/README.md`](docs/deployment-docs/README.md).
- **Documentation is part of the task, not a follow-up** — every new/changed
  endpoint and feature needs a doc entry ([`docs/README.md`](docs/README.md)).
  When a plan reaches Done, retain its file in `.scratch/<feature>/plan/`,
  mark its entry in `.scratch/<feature>/index.md` Done with date and evidence,
  and distill enduring content into `docs/` per its destination rules.
  Existing workflow artifacts, including legacy `.agents/` plans, use the
  same centralized layout; do not recreate the old locations.
- **Generate workflow text artifacts by feature, not by session or skill.**
  Before generating a file, inspect `.scratch/` and reuse the existing stable
  kebab-case feature slug (e.g. `discounts`; do not create a separate
  `discounts-implementation` folder). Put research and supporting evidence in
  `research/`; proposals, specs, and plans in `plan/`; decision maps, decision
  tickets, and design decisions in `wayfinder/`; implementation maps, tickets,
  handoffs, and verification in `ticket/`; optional prototypes in `prototype/`.
  Create only needed subfolders. Use descriptive Markdown filenames and
  numbered tickets (`NN-<slug>.md`); preserve machine-readable metadata.
  Maintain one `index.md` per feature for artifact navigation, plan approval,
  status, blockers, and verification links. There is no global status index:
  parallel feature branches must not share a status file. Ticket status stays
  in each ticket, never duplicated in the index. Link cross-feature evidence
  rather than copying it; update links when moving files. Keep skill definitions
  in `.agents/skills/` and enduring documentation in `docs/`. This placement
  policy overrides upstream skill output-path examples, not approval gates.
- **Jubelio research access.** Read-only GET requests to Jubelio may run during
  research without a separate user decision, using available credentials
  securely and reporting only redacted, relevant fields (never tokens, raw
  customer responses, or PII). Any POST (including authentication via
  `POST /login`) or other request that changes Jubelio data requires explicit
  user permission for that action/scope before it is sent. POST is not
  categorically forbidden; describe the proposed write test and safeguards
  first when applicable. Do not treat permission for one POST as permission for
  other writes or changes to existing orders.
- **No implicit commit, remote access, or push.** A plan/ticket approval does
  not authorize a commit. Commit only when the user requests or authorizes it;
  never include unrelated changes from a dirty worktree. Use the explicitly
  configured SSH connection only when the user explicitly requests the remote
  action — never initiate SSH, file transfer, remote commands, Docker
  operations, restarts, or deployment. Run `git push` only when the user
  explicitly requests it; a local commit does not imply permission to push
  or deploy it.

## 5. Testing Requirements

- **Every new feature or bug fix must ship with tests.** If no test seam
  exists, create one (extract pure helpers, expose a module-level function,
  or add an E2E spec). A task is not complete until tests cover the new behavior.
- **Before committing or opening a PR, run the test suite.** At minimum:
  - `npm run test:unit` for any logic change.
  - `npm run test:e2e` for any UI, routing, or auth change.
- **UI changes require Playwright E2E coverage.** Features touching pages,
  components, forms, or navigation get a `*.spec.ts` under `e2e/store/` or
  `e2e/admin/` asserting user-visible behavior. The canonical way to verify
  a UI feature works is to run its Playwright spec and see it pass.
- **Frontend acceptance also requires the `ux-design` review gate.** The main
  agent must inspect the rendered UI and relevant interaction states, compare
  it against an agreed peer-page/shared-pattern reference, and verify cross-page
  consistency alongside the required Playwright coverage. JSX inspection or a
  passing click test alone does not establish good UX. If browser verification
  is blocked, report that limitation and do not claim frontend completion.
- **Use the `tdd` skill** (`.agents/skills/tdd/SKILL.md`) for all test work:
  one vertical slice at a time, tests at public seams only, expected values
  from an independent source of truth (no tautological assertions), and write
  the failing test first for features and bug fixes. When an implementation is
  delegated, the subagent authors/updates tests but does not execute them; the
  main agent runs the tests and completes the red → green verification loop.
- **Verification ladder — cheap per slice, expensive per batch.** Batching test
  runs is allowed; skipping verification is not.
  - **L0 (every slice, seconds):** `npm run verify:types:store` and/or
    `npm run verify:types:admin` (`tsc --noEmit`, incremental).
  - **L1 (every slice):** `npm run verify:unit:slice -- <explicit test paths>` —
    only the files the slice touched. Never leave the file list implicit.
  - **L2 (every batch of tickets):** `npm run verify:batch:unit` (serial, compact
    reporter) plus only the mock E2E specs the batch touched:
    `npm run verify:batch:e2e -- e2e/store/<spec>-mock.spec.ts`.
  - **L3 (before commit/PR, and at the integration ticket):** the full suites
    required above. The legacy `npm run test:e2e` still needs separate
    authorization.
  - A ticket may sit at `claimed` until its batch gate passes, but it is never
    `resolved` without recorded L2/L3 evidence. Keep output bounded: capture to a
    log outside the repo or print only summary/FAIL lines, and never re-run a
    suite that already passed — record its summary line as evidence instead. New
    mock specs must also be added to `playwright.mock.config.ts` `testMatch`, or
    they silently never run.
- **Keep tests deterministic.** Do not depend on random data, time-of-day, or
  external services that are not mocked / controlled in the test environment.
- **Centralize disposable Playwright output under `/playwright/` (gitignored).**
  Standard and mock HTML reports go to `playwright/reports/{default,mock}/`;
  runner artifacts (Markdown, traces, screenshots, video) go to
  `playwright/results/{default,mock}/`. Manual browser/MCP dumps go to
  `playwright/mcp/`, optionally under a descriptive run subfolder. The MCP
  `--output-dir` applies only to automatically named files: when passing an
  explicit filename, include `playwright/mcp/<run>/...` from the repo root,
  never a bare root filename. Put optional blob/JSON/custom reporter output
  under `playwright/blob/` or `playwright/reports/<run>/`; CLI/env output
  overrides must stay inside `playwright/`. Do not create root-level
  `playwright-report*`, `test-results`, or `.playwright-mcp` directories, and
  never force-add generated artifacts. Keep test specs/config tracked;
  enduring verification summaries belong in docs or the feature's `.scratch/`
  folder, linking to disposable artifacts when helpful. `e2e/.auth/` retains
  its existing ignored storage-state contract. See
  [`docs/testing/README.md`](docs/testing/README.md) for report commands.
- **When a Playwright run fails, read the Markdown output — do NOT open the
  screenshot/image file.** Playwright emits a text/Markdown report (snapshot,
  trace, error context) alongside any `.png` attachment. Diagnose from the
  Markdown only; opening the image wastes a turn and is forbidden.

## 6. Communication With the User

- **Generate all documentation in Indonesian**, unless the user explicitly
  requests another language. This includes research notes, proposals, wayfinder
  maps and decision tickets, specifications, plans, ADRs, architecture/feature/API
  documentation, and agent-facing handoffs. Preserve commonly used English
  technical/product terms, code/API/database identifiers, file paths, commands,
  and machine-readable tracker metadata keys/values rather than translating
  them awkwardly or breaking automation. AGENTS.md remains the English-language
  agent instruction file; this exception does not make English the default for
  other generated documents. Existing documents outside the requested scope do
  not need wholesale translation, but newly generated content must follow this
  policy.
- Respond in the user's language unless they request another language. When
  responding in Indonesian, keep commonly used English technical and product
  terms in English rather than translating them literally or awkwardly. This
  applies broadly, not just to specific examples such as interface, mock,
  testing, develop, and UAT. Explain the reasoning, relevant project context,
  practical consequences, and any important caveats in enough detail for the
  user to understand the decision; avoid unexplained jargon and unnecessary
  repetition.
- Ground project-specific claims in references the user can inspect: link to
  relevant code snippets (with file paths and line numbers when available),
  files, endpoints, tests, or project documentation. For library/API claims,
  cite the documentation consulted. Distinguish verified facts from assumptions
  or proposals; never invent a reference or imply a test was run when it was not.
- Give a concrete example and a realistic case when explaining a nontrivial
  behavior, recommendation, or trade-off. Show the input/action and expected
  outcome, not just a generic analogy. Keep examples short and directly tied
  to the question; for straightforward status updates, a full case study is
  unnecessary.
- Before asking the user to decide, explain what prompted the question, what
  the agent already checked, the available options and their trade-offs, and
  what changes under each option. Recommend an option with a reason when the
  evidence supports it. Do not ask the user for facts the agent can verify in
  the repo; ask only for preferences, requirements, or decisions the user owns.
- When reporting work, state what changed, why, where to inspect it, and what
  verification ran (or why it could not run). If blocked or uncertain, say so
  explicitly and give the next actionable step.

**Example — explaining a decision:** "Store and admin authentication must stay
separate: store sessions use `client.*` cookies and the `clients` table, while
admin sessions use `admin.*` and `users` (see
[`docs/architecture/auth.md`](docs/architecture/auth.md)). For example, an
admin user opening a store-only account page should not be treated as a signed-in
store client. Reusing the admin session in the store would violate that boundary."

**Example — asking with context:** "The new stock display needs a source of
truth. The schema is owned by `packages/db/src/schema/`, and the apps consume it
(see [`docs/architecture/database.md`](docs/architecture/database.md)). Should
the storefront show stock per branch (more precise, more UI complexity) or an
aggregate across branches (simpler, hides branch availability)? I recommend per
branch if customers choose a pickup location; which behavior do you want?"
</project_instructions>
</project_context>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description:
Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

Codemode: `tools.read(args)` resolves to `string | { data: string; mimeType: string; note: string; type: "image"; }`.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description:
Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

Codemode: `tools.bash(args)` resolves to `{ output, truncated, full_output_path?, exit_code, wall_time_seconds }`.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description:
Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

Codemode: `tools.edit(args)` resolves to a string.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description:
Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

Codemode: `tools.write(args)` resolves to a string.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: web_search
toolsAdded.description:
Search the web for real-time information using your local Ollama instance's web_search API. Requires Ollama running locally with web search enabled.

Codemode: `tools.web_search(args)` resolves to a string.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return (default: 5)

toolsAdded.name: web_fetch
toolsAdded.description:
Fetch and extract text content from a web page URL using your local Ollama instance's web_fetch API. Requires Ollama running locally with web fetch enabled.

Codemode: `tools.web_fetch(args)` resolves to a string.

url.description: URL to fetch and extract content from

toolsAdded.name: ask_user_question
toolsAdded.description:
Ask the user one or more structured questions during execution. Use when you need to:
1. Gather user preferences or requirements
2. Clarify ambiguous instructions
3. Get decisions on implementation choices as you work
4. Offer choices to the user about what direction to take

Usage notes:
- Users can type a custom answer via the automatically appended "Type something." row on every question or press Esc to abandon the questionnaire. Do NOT author "Other" or "Type something." labels yourself — reserved labels are rejected at runtime.
- Use multiSelect: true when multiple answers are valid. The "Type something." row is available on every question, including when options carry a `preview`; in preview mode it expands to the full pane width while typing so the custom answer is not cramped into the narrow options column.
- If you recommend a specific option, make that the first option in the list and add "(Recommended)" at the end of the label.

Preview feature:
Use the optional `preview` field on options when presenting concrete artifacts that users need to visually compare:
- ASCII mockups of UI layouts or components
- Code snippets showing different implementations
- Diagram variations
- Configuration examples

Preview content is rendered as markdown in a monospace box. Multi-line text with newlines is supported. When any option has a preview, the UI switches to a side-by-side layout with a vertical option list on the left and preview on the right. Do not use previews for simple preference questions where labels and descriptions suffice. Note: previews are only supported for single-select questions (not multiSelect).

question.description: The complete question to ask the user. Should be clear, specific, and end with a question mark. Example: "Which library should we use for date formatting?" If multiSelect is true, phrase it accordingly, e.g. "Which features do you want to enable?"

header.description: MAX 16 CHARACTERS — hard limit, requests over the limit are rejected. Very short chip/tag shown next to the question. Examples: "Auth method", "Library", "Approach".

label.description: MAX 60 CHARACTERS — hard limit, requests over the limit are rejected. The display text for this option that the user will see and select. Should be concise (1-5 words) and clearly describe the choice.

description.description: Explanation of what this option means or what will happen if chosen. Useful for providing context about trade-offs or implications.

preview.description: Optional preview content rendered when this option is focused. Use for mockups, code snippets, or visual comparisons that help users compare options. See the tool description for the expected content format.

options.description: The available choices for this question. Must have 2-4 options. Each option should be a distinct, mutually exclusive choice (unless multiSelect is enabled). The 'Type something.' row is appended automatically — do NOT author it.

multiSelect.description: Set to true to allow the user to select multiple options instead of just one. Use when choices are not mutually exclusive.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user (1-4 questions)

toolsAdded.name: subagents_enable
toolsAdded.description: Enable pi-subagents delegation and management tools without launching work. Call when delegation is authorized by the current request or applicable user/project instructions, or when managing existing runs. Direct execution is the default; complexity alone never authorizes delegation. Full tools are available on the next model request.

toolsAdded.name: codemode
toolsAdded.description:
Run JavaScript that calls other tools. The input is raw JavaScript (not JSON, no code fence), run as an async function body in a QuickJS sandbox: top-level `await` and `return` work. No Node, file system, network, or timers.
- `await tools.<name>({ ...args })` resolves to a string, or an object if the tool's declaration says so, and rejects with an Error on failure. A tool whose declaration returns an object resolves on failure too when it returned that object; check its fields. Calls still running when the script ends are cancelled.
- Optional first line: `// @options: {"max_output_tokens": 10000, "timeout_ms": 60000}`

Globals:
- `text(value)`, `image(dataUrlOrImageBlock)`, `console.log(...)`, and top-level `return` add output; `exit()` ends the script. With several text items, each starts with a `==> text N/M <==` line, and `console` lines follow the other output in one `<console_output>` block. `image()` also saves the image to a temp file and the result names its path.
- `store(key, value)` and `load(key)` keep JSON values across codemode calls.
- `ALL_TOOLS`, `await searchTools(query, { limit?, namespace? })`, `await describeTool(name)`, `await describeNamespace(name)`: find unlisted tools, such as MCP tools.
- `models`: classifiers and image generation. Read /home/kendricko/.local/share/mise/installs/pi/1.4.0/pi/docs/codemode.md first.

toolsAdded.name: mcp__context7__resolve_library_id
toolsAdded.description:
Resolves a package/product name to a Context7-compatible library ID and returns matching libraries.

You MUST call this function before 'Query Documentation' tool to obtain a valid Context7-compatible library ID UNLESS the user explicitly provides a library ID in the format '/org/project' or '/org/project/version' in their query.

Each result includes:
- Library ID: Context7-compatible identifier (format: /org/project)
- Name: Library or package name
- Description: Short summary
- Code Snippets: Number of available code examples
- Source Reputation: Authority indicator (High, Medium, Low, or Unknown)
- Benchmark Score: Quality indicator (100 is the highest score)
- Versions: List of versions if available. Use one of those versions if the user provides a version in their query. The format of the version is /org/project/version.

For best results, select libraries based on name match, source reputation, snippet coverage, benchmark score, and relevance to your use case.

Selection Process:
1. Analyze the query to understand what library/package the user is looking for
2. Return the most relevant match based on:
- Name similarity to the query (exact matches prioritized)
- Description relevance to the query's intent
- Documentation coverage (prioritize libraries with higher Code Snippet counts)
- Source reputation (consider libraries with High or Medium reputation more authoritative)
- Benchmark Score: Quality indicator (100 is the highest score)

Response Format:
- Return the selected library ID in a clearly marked section
- Provide a brief explanation for why this library was chosen
- If multiple good matches exist, acknowledge this but proceed with the most relevant one
- If no good matches exist, clearly state this and suggest query refinements

For ambiguous queries, request clarification before proceeding with a best-guess match.

IMPORTANT: Do not call this tool more than 3 times per question. If you cannot find what you need after 3 calls, use the best result you have.

Codemode: `tools.mcp__context7__resolve_library_id(args)` resolves to `{ content, structuredContent?, isError? }`.

query.description: What to look up in the library's documentation. This is used to rank library results by relevance to what the user is trying to accomplish. The query is sent to the Context7 API for processing. Do not include any sensitive or confidential information such as API keys, passwords, credentials, personal data, or proprietary code in your query.

libraryName.description: Library name to search for and retrieve a Context7-compatible library ID. Use the official library name with proper punctuation — e.g., 'Next.js' instead of 'nextjs', 'Customer.io' instead of 'customerio', 'Three.js' instead of 'threejs'.

toolsAdded.name: mcp__context7__query_docs
toolsAdded.description:
Retrieves and queries up-to-date documentation and code examples from Context7 for any programming library or framework.

You must call 'Resolve Context7 Library ID' tool first to obtain the exact Context7-compatible library ID required to use this tool, UNLESS the user explicitly provides a library ID in the format '/org/project' or '/org/project/version' in their query.

Do not call this tool more than 3 times per question.

If you know the programming language the user is working in, pass it as `language` so the results match their setup.

Codemode: `tools.mcp__context7__query_docs(args)` resolves to `{ content, structuredContent?, isError? }`.

libraryId.description: Exact Context7-compatible library ID (e.g., '/mongodb/docs', '/vercel/next.js', '/supabase/supabase', '/vercel/next.js/v16.2.9') retrieved from 'resolve-library-id' or directly from user query in the format '/org/project' or '/org/project/version'.

query.description: What to look up in the library's documentation, scoped to a single concept. Be specific and include relevant details, but keep each query to one topic — if the user's question spans multiple distinct concepts, make a separate call per concept instead of combining them, unless the question is about how the concepts interact. Good: 'How to set up authentication with JWT in Express.js' or 'React useEffect cleanup function examples'. Bad (too vague): 'auth' or 'hooks'. Bad (too broad): 'routing and auth and caching in Next.js'. The query is sent to the Context7 API for processing. Do not include any sensitive or confidential information such as API keys, passwords, credentials, personal data, or proprietary code in your query.

language.description: Programming language the user is writing code in, such as 'Python', 'TypeScript', 'Go', or 'C#'. Ranks code examples in that language first. Leave it out when the language is unknown or does not apply.

toolsAdded.name: list_mcp_resources
toolsAdded.description:
Lists resources provided by MCP servers. Resources allow servers to share data that provides context to language models, such as files, database schemas, or application-specific information. Prefer resources over web search when possible.

Codemode: `tools.list_mcp_resources(args)` resolves to `{ server?, resources, nextCursor?, errors? }`.

server.description: MCP server name. Omit to list every server with resources.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call with the same server; omit for the first page.

toolsAdded.name: list_mcp_resource_templates
toolsAdded.description:
Lists resource templates provided by MCP servers. Parameterized resource templates allow servers to share data that takes parameters and provides context to language models, such as files, database schemas, or application-specific information. Prefer resource templates over web search when possible.

Codemode: `tools.list_mcp_resource_templates(args)` resolves to `{ server?, resourceTemplates, nextCursor?, errors? }`.

server.description: MCP server name. Omit to list every server with resources.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call with the same server; omit for the first page.

toolsAdded.name: read_mcp_resource
toolsAdded.description:
Read a specific resource from an MCP server given the server name and resource URI.

Codemode: `tools.read_mcp_resource(args)` resolves to `{ server, uri, contents }`.

I'll read the ticket first.

# Spec: PPN checkout dicatat pada Sales Order, invoice, dan payment Jubelio

Tanggal penyusunan: 2026-10-26.
Pemilik status keseluruhan dan navigasi: [index fitur](../index.md). Dokumen ini merupakan hasil `to-spec`, bukan implementation ticket atau izin menjalankan perubahan.

## 1. Pernyataan masalah

Customer sudah membayar PPN di checkout/Midtrans, tetapi kontrak provider aplikasi saat ini mencatat net barang + net ongkir tanpa PPN. Akibatnya, tagihan customer dan nilai SO/invoice/payment Jubelio berbeda. Master pajak tenant memiliki record **PPN11% dengan `tax_id:-2`**, tetapi validator aplikasi mengharuskan tax ID positif dan nominal pajak nol.

Contoh saat ini: customer membayar111000 untuk barang100000 + PPN11000, tetapi Jubelio mencatat100000. Target: keduanya111000, tanpa memungut PPN kedua dari customer.

## 2. Solusi dan keputusan hasil grilling

Keputusan produk yang telah dikonfirmasi pemilik:

1. PPN yang dibayar customer ikut dicatat sebagai pajak barang pada Jubelio; total provider sama dengan total customer, tanpa tagihan tambahan.
2. Berlaku **hanya untuk order/checkout attempt baru setelah aktivasi**. Order dan attempt existing memakai kontrak serta snapshot tersimpannya.
3. Tax ID disimpan di **`system_config`**, nilai tenant yang dibutuhkan sekarang **-2**; **tidak membuat menu admin**.
4. Lepaskan syarat tax ID positif. Tetap validasi signed safe integer, referensi master yang benar, dan penolakan ID0.
5. Jika tax ID tidak valid atau rate website berbeda dari master Jubelio, **blokir checkout sebelum pembayaran**. Tidak fallback ke No Tax, tidak mengikuti rate provider diam-diam.
6. Kebijakan existing tetap: PPN atas **net barang setelah Markdown dan Coupon/Manual Promo Code**, bukan ongkir; ceil sekali pada total dasar, Rupiah utuh; service fee0. Satu slot Offer dan funding subsidi ongkir tidak berubah.

### Approval dan batas wewenang

- Kesepahaman bersama: pemilik menjawab **“iya sudah sesuai”** atas rangkuman lima keputusan grilling, kemudian meminta dibuatkan `to-spec`.
- **Complete spec disetujui pemilik pada 2026-10-26** melalui pesan **“oke sudah saya setujui specnya”**. ## 4. User stories

1. Sebagai customer checkout, saya ingin total pembayaran tetap sama, agar pencatatan PPN di Jubelio tidak menambah tagihan saya.
2. Sebagai customer pickup, saya ingin PPN barang tercatat pada SO dan invoice sesuai rincian checkout.
3. Sebagai customer delivery, saya ingin ongkir tetap terpisah dan tidak mendadak dikenai PPN barang.
4. Sebagai customer yang memakai Markdown, saya ingin dasar PPN mengikuti harga barang setelah Markdown.
5. Sebagai customer yang memakai Coupon/Manual Promo Code barang, saya ingin PPN mengikuti net barang setelah potongan yang disetujui.
6. Sebagai customer penerima subsidi ongkir, saya ingin PPN barang tidak berubah hanya karena ongkir disubsidi.
7. Sebagai customer dengan beberapa barang, saya ingin jumlah pajak semua baris sama dengan PPN total checkout, tanpa selisih pembulatan.
8. Sebagai customer, saya ingin checkout ditahan sebelum membayar jika konfigurasi pajak salah, dengan pesan yang jelas dan form tidak hilang.
9. Sebagai customer yang melanjutkan pembayaran order existing, saya ingin nominal awal tidak berubah karena konfigurasi pajak baru.
10. Sebagai operator, saya ingin invoice dan payment Jubelio cocok dengan SO serta total yang dibayar customer.
11. Sebagai operator, saya ingin transaksi yang sudah paid tetap paid bila verifikasi provider gagal, tanpa fulfillment atau duplicate POST yang tidak aman.
12. Sebagai pengelola konfigurasi, saya ingin tax ID dapat ditetapkan melalui database tanpa membuat halaman admin baru.
13. Sebagai operator recovery, saya ingin dapat memeriksa returned IDs dan alasan mismatch tanpa akses ke credentials atau response customer mentah.
14. Sebagai Admin User yang berwenang melihat order, saya ingin order lama dan baru tetap terbaca tanpa mengubah Branch Scope atau permission.

## 5. Keputusan implementasi yang diusulkan

### 5.1 Konfigurasi dan validasi master

- Key baru: **`jubelio.salesTaxId`**, `type:number`, `value:"-2"` untuk tenant yang sudah diteliti. Tetap memakai `tax.ppnRatePercent` sebagai rate website; bukan key rate baru dan bukan hasil hitung otomatis dari tax ID.
- Nilai text DB diparse secara ketat menjadi signed safe integer nonzero; menerima-2 dan ID positif yang benar-benar ada pada master. Tolak kosong,0,pecahan,NaN/Infinity,overflow, format ambigu, dan tipe konfigurasi yang salah. Payload internal tetap number; string `"-2"` tidak boleh lolos sebagai angka pada intent JSON tanpa decoder yang eksplisit.
- Pembacaan pasangan key dilakukan **uncached/fail-closed** melalui repository terfokus, tidak memakai fallback getter generic yang menelan kegagalan DB. Rate divalidasi sebagai desimal canonical0..100 sampai6 digit pecahan, bukan float comparison mentah.
- Pada preview dan sebelum menulis attempt/intent baru, GET master pajak memakai gateway/auth/scheduler existing: `/taxes/?page=N&pageSize=100`, sampai record yang cocok ditemukan atau seluruh daftar selesai. Harus tepat satu record yang cocok, rate sama secara exact, dan mapping pajak keluaran tersedia untuk rate positif. Duplicate/malformed record atau GET gagal berarti unavailable, bukan rate0.
- Tidak ada stale-success cache atau retry write sebagai jalan keluar. Lookup GET hanya sebelum pembekuan attempt; settlement/replay tidak membaca ulang config/master untuk mengganti angka snapshot.
- Setelah attempt berhasil dicatat, tax identity/rate/nominalnya immutable. Perubahan config berikutnya berlaku pada checkout baru, bukan transaksi yang sedang dilanjutkan. Batas atomik praktis adalah snapshot tervalidasi yang ditulis ke attempt; tidak mengklaim transaksi lintas DB dan provider bersifat atomic.
- `JUBELIO_ITEM_TAX_ID` bukan authority baru dan tidak menjadi fallback writer provider3. Order lama sudah memiliki tax ID di intent; pertahankan kompatibilitas script/reader lama tanpa membaca env untuk reprice order.
- Seed DB pengembangan menyertakan konfigurasi-2; aktivasi staging/production harus memverifikasi tenant dan mengisi key secara eksplisit. Jangan menyalin ID antar tenant tanpa GET verifikasi, atau menjalankan seeder penuh pada DB operational.

### 5.2 Versi kontrak: pisahkan order lama dan baru

Usulan teknis: **pricing1 / engine1 / provider3** untuk pencatatan pajak baru. Formula customer tidak berubah; versi provider berubah karena payable dan authority pajak berubah.

| Kontrak tersimpan | Perlakuan |
| --- | --- |
| `0/0/0`, intent tanpa provider version | Legacy existing, pertahankan uang/guard semula |
| `1/1/2` | Existing tanpa pajak provider, payable net barang + net ongkir |
| `1/1/3` | Baru, payable net barang + PPN barang + net ongkir; harus mempunyai tax snapshot valid |
| Unknown/mixed version atau record tidak cocok | Fail closed; jangan fallback ke master/kontrak lama |

- Tambahkan branch decoder3, jangan mengganti makna provider2 secara global. Constraint DB menerima kombinasi baru sambil tetap menerima kombinasi lama yang sah.
- Snapshot provider3 menyimpan **`providerTax`** minimal `{ taxId, ratePercent }`; setiap pricing line menyimpan **`providerTaxAmount`** berupa decimal string Rupiah utuh. Intent create menyimpan identitas/rate serta nominal tax setiap line; paired-record authority harus cocok dengan order/attempt snapshot.
- `PricingSnapshotPayloadV1` menjadi discriminated union provider2/provider3; field wajib v3 tidak dibuat optional sehingga corruption tidak berubah menjadi pajak0. Belum ada kebutuhan tabel baru atau kolom tax ID terpisah pada `orders`: JSONB existing membawa snapshot immutable.
- Snapshot attempt luar tetap `version:1` bila envelope JSON tidak berubah; nested pricing dan create intent membedakan provider3. Pembaca semua app harus mengenal provider3 sebelum writer diaktifkan.
- Builder pure menerima konteks tax tervalidasi untuk menghasilkan3. Kemampuan membangun2 boleh dipertahankan hanya untuk explicit compatibility/test seams; endpoint order baru setelah aktivasi tidak boleh diam-diam memilih2 ketika config hilang.
- Checkout gate `discounts.contractVersion=1` adalah prerequisite writer baru karena kontrak uang berversi existing berada di gate tersebut. Gate0 tidak menjadi fallback order baru tanpa PPN setelah aktivasi; resume legacy tetap dilayani.
- Replay/recovery existing harus dideteksi **sebelum** preflight config/master baru, agar outage pajak atau perubahan key tidak menggagalkan kelanjutan order lama yang sah.

### 5.3 Formula dan alokasi pajak

```text
net_line        = source_price × quantity − whole_line_discount
net_goods       = Σ net_line
ppn_order       = ceil(net_goods × website_rate / 100)
provider_line   = net_line + allocated_line_tax
provider_payable = net_goods + ppn_order + net_shipping
customer_total   = provider_payable                    # service fee0
```

- Source price dan diskon barang tetap mengikuti kontrak existing: `disc_amount` mencakup Markdown + alokasi Coupon per whole line, tidak dikalikan quantity dua kali. Jangan menaikkan `price` untuk menyembunyikan PPN.
- **Usulan alokasi teknis:** hitung pajak exact setiap whole line; ambil floor, lalu bagikan selisih menuju `ppn_order` menurut fractional remainder terbesar. Tie-break `variantId` ascending secara ordinal; jangan bergantung urutan array atau locale. Baris net0 menerima tax0. Jika semua dasar0, seluruh tax0 tanpa pembagian nol.
- Hasil akhir wajib `Σ providerTaxAmount = ppnAmount`, tidak mengubah ceil tingkat order menjadi ceil per line. Gunakan exact integer/BigInt/rate scaled, bukan float epsilon untuk menentukan rate atau alokasi.
- Finalisasi tax line dilakukan **setelah** Markdown/Coupon/shipping subsidy final. Evaluator promo tidak boleh menjatuhkan tax identity saat membangun ulang snapshot, atau membawa alokasi lama setelah benefit berubah.
- Semua bounds uang/quantity dan batas50 baris existing tetap berlaku. Tidak menambah gross/net tax field yang tidak terdokumentasi atau menyamarkan pajak sebagai fee/item barang.

Contoh acceptance independen, rate11%:

| Kasus | Expected |
| --- | --- |
| Pickup barang100000 | Tax11000, line111000, provider/customer111000 |
| Qty2 ×100000 | Whole-line tax22000, line222000; bukan tax11000 yang dikalikan lagi secara salah |
| Barang150000, Coupon20000 | Net130000, tax14300, total144300 |
| Delivery barang150000, ongkir30000 | Tax16500, provider/customer196500 |
| Delivery barang150000, ongkir30000, subsidi20000 | Net ongkir10000, tax16500, provider/customer176500; quote/booking tetap30000 |
| Dua variant net100001 masing-masing | Dasar200002, tax order22001; alokasi11001/11000 menurut tie-break, total222003 |
| Net barang0 dengan net ongkir10000 | Tax0, payable10000; tidak menambah requirement payment0 |

Contoh selain fixture tunggal100000/11000 adalah target yang harus diuji, bukan hasil canary yang sudah terbukti.

### 5.4 JSON provider, invoice, payment, dan mirror

Mapping provider3:

| Field request SO | Sumber |
| --- | --- |
| `is_tax_included` | false |
| `items[].tax_id` | signed tax ID dari snapshot tervalidasi, initial-2 |
| `items[].tax_amount` | `providerTaxAmount` seluruh line |
| `items[].amount` | Source whole-line gross − whole-line discount + line tax |
| `sub_total`, `total_disc` | Gross source dan total whole-line discount existing |
| `total_tax` | Jumlah line tax = `ppnAmount` |
| `grand_total` | Frozen provider payable = total customer |
| Original/net shipping | Mapping existing; `shipping_cost_discount` tetap omitted |
| Fee/header additional discount | Tetap0 |

- Invoice conversion tetap `{ salesorder_id }`; tidak mengirim ulang pajak. GET invoice wajib memeriksa **tax identity dan nominal per line**, bukan hanya header total.
- Payment tetap memakai `amount` dan association `payment_amount` sebesar payable tersimpan, kini termasuk PPN. Tidak menambahkan tax ID/tax amount pada payment request karena pajak dimiliki invoice.
- Account/type payment tetap konfigurasi sah existing; keberhasilan account2/type0 sandbox tidak boleh mengubah default operational.
- Pertahankan returned-ID persistence sebelum GET, at-most-once claim, timeout/5xx/mismatch → manual review, tanpa blind retry atau automatic reprice/cancel. Transaksi paid tetap paid dan fulfillment ditahan sampai invoice/payment sesuai.
- SO `is_paid:null` tidak menjadi alasan menyimpulkan unpaid bila invoice payment amount dan payment association membuktikan paid/due0.
- **Mirror Status Channel wajib version-aware**: full-payload edit mempertahankan tax ID, mode exclusive, nominal line/header, detail IDs, invoice link, diskon dan shipping. Nonzero tax hanya boleh lolos bila persis cocok snapshot provider3. Guard lama tetap berlaku pada2/legacy; jangan menghapus semua guard tax secara global.

### 5.5 Kontrak kegagalan dan logging

Usulan kontrak HTTP baru pada preview/place-order: **503**, `success:false`, `code:"CHECKOUT_TAX_UNAVAILABLE"`, `error:"Checkout belum dapat diproses karena konfigurasi pajak belum sesuai. Silakan coba lagi nanti."`, dan `requestId` mengikuti pola existing; `Cache-Control:no-store`.

- Dipakai untuk config hilang/rusak, tax tidak ditemukan, rate mismatch, dan dependency lookup gagal. Browser tidak menerima credentials, payload master, nama akun, atau rincian rate mismatch internal.
- Pada kegagalan sebelum attempt: tidak ada SO/invoice/payment/Midtrans baru, Promo Reservation, order, perubahan cart, atau hold stok yang tertinggal. Request admission/audit counters yang sudah menjadi proteksi existing boleh tetap tercatat.
- Preview lama tidak dapat mengotorisasi pembayaran bila config tax berubah sebelum placement. Sertakan tax identity/rate/provider version dalam review fingerprint; review stale meminta review ulang, bukan membayar memakai approval lama.
- Jika gagal setelah write mungkin terkirim, gunakan lifecycle/manual-review existing, bukan menyamarkannya sebagai error preflight yang aman untuk create ulang.
- Logger app module-scope: `info` pada keberhasilan checkpoint/use case dan `error` tersanitasi pada kegagalan dependency; reason seperti missing_config/tax_not_found/rate_mismatch untuk diagnosis aman di message. Jangan meneruskan logger/requestId melalui parameter atau mencetak payload/PII/token.

- Repository baru: `readCheckoutTaxConfig(database?): Promise<CheckoutTaxConfig>`; `CheckoutTaxConfig` membawa `taxId:number` dan `ppnRatePercent:string` yang strict; database default app-local.

- Gateway: `getTaxRecord(taxId:number): Promise<JubelioTaxRecord | null>`; DTO minimal tax identity, canonical rate, output account availability. Tambahan tidak mengekspor raw master/customer response.
- Pure module baru: `allocateProviderTax(input: { lines: readonly { variantId:string; netLineAmount:string }[]; ppnRatePercent:string; ppnAmount:string }): readonly { variantId:string; providerTaxAmount:string }[]`.
- Schema: `ValidatedProviderTax = { taxId:number; ratePercent:string }`; shared schema tidak mengimpor tipe app. Pricing union provider3 mewajibkan `providerTax` dan per-line `providerTaxAmount`; create intent3 mewajibkan frozen tax context dan tax amount per line.
- Builder: `buildPricingSnapshot(input: BuildPricingSnapshotInput): PricingSnapshot` dengan input tax context baru; `evaluatePricing(input: EvaluatePricingInput): PricingSnapshot` meneruskan konteks tersebut. Decoder `decodePricingSnapshot(payload:unknown)` dan `readOrderPricing(row:PersistedOrderPricingRow)` mempertahankan signature, return union meluas.

- Review: `CheckoutReviewPricing` menambah tax snapshot minimal untuk fingerprint provider3; fungsi signing/verifying existing mempertahankan call shape dengan tipe context yang meluas.
- UI baru: `CheckoutTaxFeedback({ message:string; busy:boolean; onReviewAgain:()=>void })`; error preflight bukan `CheckoutAttemptResult` palsu.

### Alasan struktur

- Tax preflight dipisahkan dari transport dan query karena mengoordinasikan config DB dengan master provider serta equality rate. Repository bukan pass-through CRUD, melainkan strict pair read tanpa fallback existing.
- Gateway taxes memakai auth/scheduler Sales existing; tidak menambah token store, HTTP client generik, atau retry layer lain.
- Alokasi/decode money tetap pure di package DB agar reader admin/store satu aturan; package tidak mengambil runtime DB app.
- `CheckoutTaxFeedback` memisahkan preflight tanpa attempt dari feedback attempt durable existing. Reuse tokens/Button/pattern, bukan membentuk attempt palsu agar bisa memakai komponen lama.
- Tidak menaikkan pricing engine versi hanya karena payable provider berubah; provider3 dan discriminated snapshot mengisolasi perubahan tersebut. Bila discovery menemukan incompatibility yang membutuhkan versi harga baru, kembalikan ke review spec, jangan diam-diam mengganti versi.

## 8. Acceptance criteria dan keputusan testing

Public seams utama: **preview/place checkout → provider gateway mock → invoice/payment lifecycle**, ditambah browser checkout. Pure money dan stored decoder mendapat tests terfokus karena rounding/version integrity sulit dibuktikan hanya lewat browser. Seams ini mengikuti perilaku yang digrill: sama total, old-order compatibility, dan blokir sebelum payment; telah disetujui sebagai bagian complete spec pada 2026-10-26, tetapi bukan dianggap sudah ditest.

1. Key-2 valid + website11/master11 menghasilkan provider3, tax line/header benar, total customer/provider sama; Midtrans item details menjumlah ke total yang sama tanpa PPN kedua.
2. ID negatif existing diterima, positive ID valid juga bisa;0,missing,null,string pada intent,pecahan,overflow dan ID tidak ada ditolak. Raw DB text diparse sesuai aturan config, bukan coercion intent.
3. Config DB unavailable/malformed atau taxes GET failure/duplicate record/rate mismatch menghasilkan503/copy yang disepakati; **tidak ada provider business POST/Midtrans baru atau hold/promo/cart mutation**.
4. Kesetaraan rate menerima canonical equivalent `11`, `11.00` dari sumber yang sah; `11` versus `12` ditolak, tanpa fallback rate/default atau auto-reprice.
5. Semua worked money examples §5.3 mendapat literal expected tests: qty2, diskon, shipping/subsidy, multi-line rounding, net0 dengan shipping positif. Jumlah tax line harus tepat ppnAmount; urutan input tidak mengubah alokasi per variant.
6. Builder/evaluator tidak kehilangan tax context setelah Offer berubah. Review fingerprint berubah ketika tax identity/rate/provider version berubah, walaupun total kebetulan sama; stale approval tidak dipakai membayar.
7. Order/attempt v0/v2 existing resume, invoice/payment, cancel dan mirror tetap memakai snapshot lama walaupun key baru hilang/rate berubah/provider taxes outage. Test campuran versi/intent/order mismatch menahan write tanpa fallback.
8. GET SO/invoice memeriksa signed tax ID, tax amount line/header, quantities/prices/discounts/mode, total dan linkage. Header benar tetapi line salah harus gagal. Invoice payment111000/due0 membuktikan lunas walau SO is_paidnull.
9. Paid order dengan invoice/payment mismatch atau timeout mempertahankan paid dan returned IDs, fulfillment tertahan/manual review, tidak membuat write kedua. Concurrent duplicate request/webhook tidak menggandakan SO/invoice/payment.
10. Full-payload marker edits sebelum/sesudah invoice/payment mempertahankan pajak/detail/linkage dan money; ubah marker saja. Verifier unknown/mixed version tetap fail closed.
11. Shared admin reader menerima order0/2/3; view order lama tidak gagal, Branch Scope/permission tidak berubah. Jangan mengubah auth/session boundary.
12. E2E mock checkout membuktikan total unchanged, error inline jelas, payment tidak terbuka saat invalid tax, retry tidak menggandakan submit, dan form/promo/cart dipertahankan.
13. DB tests membuktikan kombinasi versi baru diterima dan unknown/mixed ditolak, promotion attempt tidak membuang frozen tax snapshot; reset/seed DB disposable tetap bekerja.
14. Documents/config templates menjelaskan source DB, fail-closed, compatible readers dan rollback; tidak ada sandbox credential/PII/response customer raw dalam log/evidence.

Ini urutan internal, **bukan publikasi breakdown tickets**.

Hasil sesi ini hanya spec dan index. Tidak ada kode/schema/config/seed yang diubah, tidak ada request Jubelio baru, tidak ada tests/build/typecheck aplikasi yang dijalankan. Bukti vendor di §3 berasal dari pengujian yang sudah dilaporkan, bukan run baru saat drafting.

# Harga checkout berversi (pricing1 / engine1 / provider2)

Dokumen ini menjelaskan **kontrak uang checkout tanpa promo** yang disimpan
sebagai snapshot berversi pada order. Fokusnya: rincian uang authoritative
(barang, PPN, ongkir, total customer, payable provider), decoder yang fail
closed, dan batas input.

Cakupan yang **tidak** ada di sini: Offer/Coupon, Markdown, Manual Promo Code,
dan hasil UAT/release. Review checkout (token/fingerprint), request key/replay,
result lookup, dan admission rate-limit dibahas pada §12. Semua itu ticket
berikutnya pada
[peta implementasi diskon](../../.scratch/discounts/ticket/map.md) dan
[spec lengkap §4/§8.3/§10/§13](../../.scratch/discounts/plan/discounts-spec.md). Dokumen ini tidak
menyatakan satu pun acceptance ticket sudah lulus.

## 1. Gate versi kontrak

Gate adalah satu baris konfigurasi domain di `system_config` (key
`discounts.contractVersion`), **bukan** env var:

- Pembaca gate: `getDiscountsContractVersion()`
  (`apps/store/src/lib/config.ts`) — membaca `system_config` **tanpa cache**,
  sehingga perubahan nilai berlaku pada request berikutnya (tanpa restart).
- Baris hilang atau nilai `"0"` → **legacy 0**. Nilai `"1"` → kontrak baru.
  Nilai lain (termasuk kosong/`"2"`) **atau** kegagalan baca DB → **throw**,
  tidak pernah diam-diam dianggap legacy.
- Seeder menulis baris ini **eksplisit** dengan value `"0"`
  (`packages/db/src/seed.ts`, bagian system config, dijalankan di kedua mode
  `SEED_MODE`), jadi DB hasil `db:reset && db:seed` berada di legacy 0. Baris yang
  absen (mis. DB lama/manual) tetap dibaca legacy 0, bukan error.
- Gate `1` saat ini hanya dipakai fixture DB **disposable** pada test mock: spec
  menulis baris gate itu sendiri sebelum skenario berjalan. Dokumen ini sengaja
  tidak memuat perintah aktivasi operasional — menaikkan gate di
  staging/production adalah keputusan rollout terpisah yang belum diotorisasi,
  dan gate tetap `0` sampai matriks kompatibilitas §8 terbukti.
- Nilai yang berlaku cukup dibaca dari baris tersebut (read-only), mis.
  `SELECT value FROM system_config WHERE key = 'discounts.contractVersion'`;
  dokumen ini tidak menjadi sumber kebenaran gate.

## Sandbox-observed runtime contract (2026-09-24, `.env` test account)

Verified end-to-end via `npm run sandbox:sales` (apps/store):

- `POST /sales/orders/` → `{id}`; SO GET returns `is_canceled: null` (not
  `false`) for active orders and carries `invoice_id` after conversion.
- Stock series after SO create: `on_order +1`, `available −1`,
  `on_hand`/`reserved` unchanged; confirmed cancel reverses it. The provider
  `available` can go negative when oversold; local snapshots clamp at 0.
- `tax_id` must reference a real tax record — `0` fails the provider FK
  (HTTP 500 after send). The account's "No Tax" record is `1` (`rate 0.00`);
  configured via `JUBELIO_ITEM_TAX_ID`.
- `POST /sales/packlists/create-invoice` `{salesorder_id}` →
  `{status:"ok", id}` where `id` is the **Sales Invoice Number**.
  `GET /sales/invoices/{id}` exposes money as decimal strings and
  `salesorder_id: null` — the SO link is proven by the SO GET's `invoice_id`.
- `POST /sales/payments/` requires a **numeric** `payment_type` (0 = cash/
  other on this account), accepts `payment_no: "[auto]"` and
  `transaction_date`; response `{status:"ok", id}` where `id` is the
  `payment_id`. `GET /sales/payments/{id}` returns `invoices[]`
  verifikasi pembayaran yang ternormalisasi. Tidak ada token/snapshot di DTO
  publik.
- `jubelio_sales_operation` dan `discount_redemption` dapat dimiliki attempt
  (`checkout_attempt_id`) sebelum `order_id` ada. Constraint owner mewajibkan
  tepat satu pemilik; `invoice`/`payment` tetap wajib sudah dipromosikan.
- SO ditolak pasti sebelum diterapkan: hold stok/promo dilepas **sekali**, tidak
  ada Midtrans, tidak ada order/email gagal; customer tetap di checkout.
- Respons ambigu (timeout/5xx, klaim lokal gagal) tidak pernah dianggap gagal:
  attempt menjadi `manual_review`/`processing`, tanpa POST ulang dan tanpa
  pelepasan hold. Hanya rejection 401 terverifikasi dari SDK Snap (Context7
  `midtrans-nodejs-client`, error `httpStatusCode`/`ApiResponse`) yang dianggap
  definitive untuk pembatalan SO; 4xx lain — termasuk `order_id` duplikat —
  tetap ambigu.
- Cancel SO harus **confirmed** sebelum stok dikembalikan dan retry dibuka.
- Retry key yang sama melanjutkan attempt yang tersimpan (bukan reserve ulang);
  key berbeda saat attempt belum selesai ditolak `409 CHECKOUT_ATTEMPT_IN_PROGRESS`.
- Sweep cron memulihkan attempt: klaim intent yang belum pernah dikirim,
  menyelesaikan promotion lokal yang tertunda, dan meng-*abort* reservation
  kedaluwarsa yang SO-nya belum pernah dikirim. Hasil possibly-sent hanya
  GET/review.
=== versioned tail ===
- `shipping_before_subsidy` / `service.shippingCost` delivery snapshot:
  ongkir quote/booking ORIGINAL (contoh 30000).
- `shipping_subsidy` + `merchant_funding`: subsidi merchant (contoh 20000).
- `shippingCost` / `pricing.shippingCost`: ongkir NET customer (contoh 10000).
- `providerQuotedShippingCost`: quote cost yang diketahui (delivery: nilai quote).
- `providerBilledShippingCost`: NULL sampai ada evidence billed; diisi lewat
  ledger shipment existing, bukan ditebak.

Packing/booking/recovery membaca komponen original (`service.shippingCost`),

Limit efektif `discount.import.maxRows` dibaca **uncached** per request: kelebihan → `400 ROW_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` tanpa mutation; config invalid → `503 IMPORT_LIMITS_INVALID` (fail closed). Row kosong/duplikat/bentuk salah → `400 INPUT_INVALID`; SKU tak dikenal atau source invalid pada row target fixed tetap di-stage dengan `variantId: null` + warning dan difinalkan `failed` saat apply, sedangkan row shortcut persen untuk SKU/source yang tidak resolvable ditolak `400 INPUT_INVALID` (target fixed tidak bisa dibekukan). Gate 0 → `503 DISCOUNTS_INACTIVE`.
306:- `GET /api/admin/price-changes/{id}` — `prices:view` global + products view-all. Query `page` (≥1), `limit` (default 25, maks 100), `state` (`all` default; `pending|applied|unchanged|failed`). Counts selalu menggambarkan **seluruh** batch; `rows` hanya halaman yang diminta (`preview`, `state`, `resultCode`, `actual` before/after, `appliedRevisionId`) plus `pagination { page, limit, total, totalPages }` — cukup untuk report/subset retry tanpa arsip file. Nilai `state` lain → `400 INPUT_INVALID`. Id tak dikenal/denied → `404 NOT_FOUND`/`403 DENIED`.
307:- `POST /api/admin/price-changes/{id}/apply` — `prices:edit`. Body `{ requestKey: UUID, previewDigest?: string|null }`. Foreground chunk: maksimum **25 row atau 5 detik** per request, tiap row satu transaksi bounded (lock batch→row→variant/source→current Markdown, validasi target terhadap source **terbaru**, revision immutable + current pointer + hasil row + audit). Respons `202` selama `pendingCount > 0`, `200` saat final; resume manual memakai request key baru dan hanya memproses row pending. Ledger `price_change_apply_request` unik `(actor_identity, request_key)`: key sama pada batch + digest sama melanjutkan/replay tanpa hasil row kedua, beda → `409 REQUEST_KEY_CONFLICT`. No-op → `unchanged` tanpa revision fiktif, tetap satu audit. Halt `POLICY_REVOKED` (grant dicabut di tengah chunk; row yang sudah commit tetap) dan `ROW_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (batch melebihi limit baris terbaru; row pending ditahan) dikembalikan sebagai `haltReason`, bukan sukses. Bila grant sudah dicabut **sebelum** request dimulai, respons adalah `403 DENIED`; halt reason tetap dicatat pada batch dan hanya dapat dibaca viewer yang masih memegang `prices:view` + products view-all. Config limit invalid → `503 IMPORT_LIMITS_INVALID`; lock/serialization → `503 BUSY`. Counts selalu menjumlah `rowCount`; money tetap decimal string.

Untuk **pickup**, body strict `{ phone, email, pickupDate, pickupTime, selectedItemIds, promoSelection: { kind: "none" } | { kind: "public", offerId } }`. Read-only: tidak membuat order/hold/usage dan tidak memanggil provider. Setiap item membawa `benefitKind` (`fixed_goods` | `percentage_goods` | `shipping`), `rate`, `capAmount`, dan `benefitAmount` = nominal aktual untuk context ini. `shippingBeforeSubsidy` pada delivery hanya dipakai untuk menampilkan eligibility subsidi; angka ini bukan sumber uang order dan preview/place-order selalu memakai quote baru. 1. Generate secret: `openssl rand -hex 32` → set sebagai `JUBELIO_WEBHOOK_SECRET`
   dan sebagai **Webhook Secret Key** di Jubelio.
2. Di Jubelio UI: **Pengaturan → Developer → Webhook**. Daftarkan callback URL
   `https://<store-domain>/api/webhooks/jubelio` untuk action `update-product`,
   `update-price`, `update-qty`.
3. Jubelio menandatangani `HMAC-SHA256(rawBody + secret, secret)` (hex) di header `Sign`.
   Handler juga menerima alias lama `webhook-signature` dan
   `x-jubelio-signature`, lalu memverifikasi raw body — 503 jika secret unset,
   401 jika signature salah, 500 jika upsert gagal (Jubelio retry sampai 3×).

Payload minimal (cuma `item_group_id` + action) → handler re-fetch state
terbaru dari Jubelio lalu upsert. Tiap call dicatat di `audit_log`
(`action: "JUBELIO_SYNC_WEBHOOK"`).

```sql
-- thumbnail + gallery terisi

```

1. **`approvedPricing.providerTax` ditolak schema** — preview delivery mengirim identitas pajak ke browser, lalu `approvedPricing` yang dikirim balik gagal validasi (`400 INPUT_BODY`). Perbaikan: `publicPricingOf()` di [`checkout-delivery-review.ts`](apps/store/src/lib/checkout-delivery-review.ts) — tax id tetap hanya di fingerprint server (sesuai spec §5.5: browser tidak menerima tax id internal).
2. **Mock `GET /sales/orders/{id}` tidak mengembalikan `tax_amount`/`disc_amount` per baris** — semua create provider3 jadi `manual_review` karena verifikasi per-baris tidak bisa membuktikan pajak. Perbaikan: mock kini contract-faithful (SO & invoice GET membawa pajak per baris).
3. **Banner pajak hanya dirender di step 2** — padahal kegagalan preflight terjadi di step 1, jadi customer tidak melihat pesan. Perbaikan: [`checkout/page.tsx`](apps/store/src/app/checkout/page.tsx) merender `CheckoutTaxFeedback` di step 1 dan step 2.

## Yang ditambahkan

- **Mock provider** [`apps/jubelio-mock/src/server.ts`](apps/jubelio-mock/src/server.ts): `GET /taxes/` berpagination (default tenant: `-2`/11.00 dengan `tax_out`, `-1`/10.00, `1`/No Tax) + `PUT /__control/taxes` untuk skenario gagal; GET SO/invoice memuat `tax_id`/`tax_amount`/`disc_amount`. 5 test baru (41 total pass).
- **E2E mock** [`e2e/store/checkout-review-mock.spec.ts`](e2e/store/checkout-review-mock.spec.ts) — 2 test baru sesuai AC §8.12:
  - preview → `503 CHECKOUT_TAX_UNAVAILABLE`, copy final, `Cache-Control: no-store`, tanpa SO/Midtrans/attempt baru, cart utuh, tidak ada detail master di body;
  - UI: banner `role=alert`, heading "Pembayaran" tidak muncul, form/cart dipertahankan, lalu "Periksa ulang pesanan" setelah config diperbaiki membuka pembayaran tanpa submit ganda.
- **Penyesuaian ekspektasi provider3** di `versioned-checkout-mock` & `versioned-settlement-mock`: `providerContractVersion: 3`, payable = total customer (166.500 pickup / 196.500 delivery), `total_tax`/`tax_amount` per baris, dan assertion lama "provider ledger ≠ customer total" dibalik sesuai keputusan spec.
